q.instruction: 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것의 개수는? (①1개~⑤5개)
q.passage: ⓐ<u>A find B take C make D put</u> Rewrite each sentence using the word in brackets. 1 Catching a bug while he was in hospital ⓑ<u>meant the old men died</u> sooner than he would otherwise have done. (hastened) 2 Cinderella ⓒ<u>were treated very badly</u> by her wicked stepmother. (suffer) 3 A large number of the public ⓓ<u>expressed their grief</u> when the film star died. (outpouring) 4 The accident ⓔ<u>has made people feel</u> more afraid with regard to safety on the railways. (fuelled) 5 Because of their behaviour our only alternative is to boycott their goods. (left) 6 It was unwise of him to act as he did. (lapse) 7 I was extremely worried when Dad was having his operation. (sick) 8 It’s better to give vent to your feelings. (bottle) Use a dictionary such as the Cambridge Online Dictionary to find two ways of completing each of these collocations – one from the unit and one more. 1 a fit of 2 to shatter 3 to fill someone with 4 to hurl at someone 5 in a state of 6 pose a
q.explanation:
틀린 곳은 ⓑ(meant the old men died → meant the old man died), ⓒ(were treated very badly → was treated very badly), ⓓ(expressed their grief → expressed its grief) — 총 3개.
【출제의도】 문장 구조 속 어법 요소(수일치·시제·태·준동사·병렬 등)의 정오를 판단하는 능력을 평가한다.
